sources.title: Atlantic Salmon species profile
sources.relevantParaphrase: Adult/general preference is approximately 4–12 C and the cited upper lethal value is 27.8 C.
sources.limitations: Life stage and acclimation vary; curve is a broad compatibility response.

sources.title: Northern Pike Management Plan
sources.relevantParaphrase: Northern pike are coolwater fish; warm surface water drives use of cooler available habitat.
